configs.label: IVF nprobe 128, rerank 128
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id, stats FROM {table} WHERE embedding MATCH :q AND k = :k AND nprobe = 128 AND rerank_k = 128 AND rerank = 2

configs.label: IVF nprobe 512, rerank 128
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id, stats FROM {table} WHERE embedding MATCH :q AND k = :k AND nprobe = 512 AND rerank_k = 128 AND rerank = 2

configs.label: FTS5 bm25 (AND)
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q ORDER BY rank LIMIT :k

configs.label: FTS5 bm25 (OR)
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q ORDER BY rank LIMIT :k

configs.label: FTS5 bm25c (OR)
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q AND rank MATCH 'bm25c()' ORDER BY rank LIMIT :k

configs.label: FTS5 unranked (AND)
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q LIMIT :k

configs.label: warp nprobe 8
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id, stats FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q AND k = :k AND nprobe = 8 AND opts = 'layout=warp stoplist=0.02'

configs.label: warp nprobe 32
configs.sql: SELECT rowid AS id, stats FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH :q AND k = :k AND nprobe = 32 AND opts = 'layout=warp stoplist=0.02'
